subject: Control plane heartbeat outage — customer update & action plan
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@evolvemeds.ai>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@evolvemeds.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T08:12:03-07:00
Subject: Control plane heartbeat outage — initial notice

Hi Emily,

We detected intermittent heartbeat failures between the Redwood control plane and your private VPC deployment starting at 07:45 PDT. Some inference requests routed through the control plane saw 5–10% transient failures and increased tail latency. Our on-call engineering team is investigating now.

What we're doing now:
- Collecting control plane + agent logs (attached: controlplane-heartbeat-logs-20260610.zip)
- Switching affected nodes to a fallback routing policy to reduce failures
- Notifying SRE and opening a dedicated incident bridge

Can you confirm whether any scheduled jobs were running during that window? We want to correlate.

I'll post interim updates on this thread every hour or sooner for critical changes.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: controlplane-heartbeat-logs-20260610.zip (log bundle, ~12MB)

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@evolvemeds.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@evolvemeds.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T08:35:21-07:00
Subject: Re: Control plane heartbeat outage — initial notice

Thanks Rohan — we saw degraded throughput and about 6% failed requests for our 08:00–08:20 window (production inference). No scheduled jobs on our side during that time. We captured several 504s in our logs; I can share a sample if helpful.

This is impacting a small set of user-facing flows; our on-call has started throttling queues to reduce user errors. Can you share the ETA for a fix? If this will take longer, we need a mitigation plan or rollback.

Emily
Director of ML Platform
EvolveMed

Attachment: evolve-prod-504-sample.log (1.2MB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@evolvemeds.ai>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@evolvemeds.ai>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:22:47-07:00
Subject: Re: Control plane heartbeat outage — initial notice

Hi Emily — Monica from Customer Success & Platform.

Quick technical update:
- Root cause (prelim): a race condition in the heartbeat backoff logic within the control-plane agent that, under a particular packet loss pattern in one AZ, caused agent heartbeats to be suppressed for ~2–3m before reconnection.
- Mitigation applied: increased heartbeat aggressiveness and temporary rollback of the recent agent sidecar change for your deployment; this decreased failures immediately on our tests.
- Next steps: we will roll a hotfix to all nodes in your VPC tonight (scheduled window 22:00–22:30 PDT) unless you prefer an immediate rollback.

We will provide a short post-incident summary and share the log bundle once we've completed aggregation. We're also happy to set up a 30m review with your platform team tomorrow to walk the timeline and action items.

Apologies for the disruption — we recognize the customer impact and are prioritizing this.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jun 10, 2026 at 8:12 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We detected intermittent heartbeat failures ... (see above)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@evolvemeds.ai>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@evolvemeds.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:26:10-07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary & proposed remediation for control-plane heartbeat incident

Hi Emily,

Thanks for your patience while we investigated. Attached is a short customer-facing summary (customer-impact-summary.pdf) and the internal postmortem is linked below.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Incident window: 2026-06-10 07:45–08:25 PDT
- Impact: transient 5–7% request failures for EvolveMed production traffic routed via Redwood control plane
- Root cause: regression in agent heartbeat backoff logic that suppressed heartbeats under specific packet-loss patterns in one AZ
- Immediate remediation: rolled back the sidecar change for your deployment, applied heartbeat aggressiveness update; hotfix rolled to all nodes in your VPC on 2026-06-10 22:15 PDT

Action items (we will complete in next 30 days):
1) Add deterministic integration tests that simulate packet loss patterns (owner: SRE)
2) Harden heartbeat logic to avoid suppression windows longer than 10s (owner: Runtime)
3) Improved observability: add dedicated heartbeat metrics and alert thresholds for private deployments (owner: Telemetry)
4) Offer: one month of service credit for the affected capacity tier (we've started the credit process and attached signed MAF)

Links & artifacts:
- Public incident record: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-06-10-controlplane-heartbeat
- Internal postmortem: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-06-12-evolvemed-controlplane-heartbeat

Please let me know if you'd like to schedule the 30m walkthrough; I'm available tomorrow 09:00–12:00 PDT or Friday afternoon.

Apologies again — we value the partnership and will keep you updated as we close the action items.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: customer-impact-summary.pdf, signed-maf-EvolveMed.pdf
